questions.q: What effect does Wonder Woman's golden lasso have on anyone it binds?
questions.why: Anyone caught in the lasso can only speak the truth.

questions.q: What is the name of Wonder Woman's island home?
questions.why: Her home island, formerly Paradise Island, is called Themyscira.

questions.q: Which U.S. pilot crashes on the Amazon island and is returned to Man's World?
questions.why: Steve Trevor crashed on the island and Diana brought him home.

options: William Moulton Marston and H. G. Peter
Bill Finger, Bob Kane and Jerry Robinson
questions.why: Marston wrote as Charles Moulton, with H. G. Peter drawing.

questions.q: In her original origin, how was Diana created?
options: Sculpted from clay by Queen Hippolyta
Born to Zeus and Queen Hippolyta of Themyscira
Found on a boat by Amazons
questions.why: The original clay origin has Hippolyta sculpt Diana and the gods give her life.

questions.q: In which film did Gal Gadot first play the Amazon princess?
questions.why: Gadot debuted in 2016's Batman v Superman.

questions.q: Who directed the 2017 Wonder Woman film?
In which year did Wonder Woman debut in All Star Comics #8?
questions.why: She debuted in All Star Comics #8 in late 1941.

questions.q: During which years did Lynda Carter's Wonder Woman TV series run?
Whose bracelets inspired Wonder Woman's bracelets?
questions.why: Marston took the idea from bracelets worn by Olive Byrne.
